gates.title: Brand clearance
gates.evidence_required: Exact/similar marks, prior Xenda/PiXENDA concerns, common-law/domain/linguistic/registry review
gates.safe_behavior: Internal descriptive repository and product implementation continue

gates.title: Legal/privacy/source proof
gates.evidence_required: Actual jurisdictions, audience/children-related collection policy if relevant, sender identity, purpose classes, consent wording, import provenance, retention/erasure basis
gates.blocks: Production handling/sending for unapproved use cases
gates.safe_behavior: Build/test with synthetic data; hold uncertain imports; do not infer audience age/location

gates.title: Stack/editor compatibility
gates.evidence_required: Locked version manifest, licenses/SBOM, Payload/domain transaction tests, migrations, editor codec/render fixtures
gates.blocks: First integration release and affected dependency activation
gates.safe_behavior: Domain work continues; replace editor/adapter if needed

gates.title: Email provider/sender
gates.evidence_required: Intended marketing use allowed, account quotas/scope, idempotency/batch/webhook tests, DNS and raw test-message auth, suppression/reconciliation capabilities

gates.title: Hosting/recovery/workload
gates.evidence_required: Account/region/budget, measured workload profile, private networking, PITR/export/journal configuration, load and restore drill
gates.safe_behavior: Portable container/dev work continues; no invented scale claims

gates.title: Operator usability
gates.evidence_required: Representative tasks, consequence comprehension, timing/error observations, accessibility checks
gates.blocks: Wider rollout if targets materially fail
gates.safe_behavior: Improve views/recipes; no change to permission semantics

gates.title: New channel
gates.evidence_required: Demand, markets, consent, sender program, replies, cost, provider limits, device/site/privacy tests

gates.title: Security readiness
gates.owner: Engineering owner + competent independent review before broad production
gates.evidence_required: Threat model, authorization/MFA paths, secrets, SSRF/injection/IDOR tests, vulnerabilities, incident and recovery evidence
gates.safe_behavior: No public/live audience processing until required findings close

gates.title: AI qualification
gates.evidence_required: Data terms, task evaluations, prompt-injection tests, accuracy/cost caps, failure behavior

gates.title: Kit migration evidence
gates.evidence_required: Real account topology, all statuses, publications mapped, source coverage, active progress/exports, stop controls and authority transfer evidence
gates.safe_behavior: Shadow read-only staging; never dual live sending or guessed progress

gates.title: External-agent access qualification
gates.evidence_required: Actual identity/delegation runtime, OAuth/token boundaries, tool evaluations, approval separation, revocation/rate/spend and computer-use tests
gates.blocks: External-agent writes and any represented human-only approval path
gates.safe_behavior: Manual UI and internal implementation continue; read/proposal pilot only after narrower approval

gates.title: Voice and interaction privacy
gates.evidence_required: STT/TTS terms, retention/region, microphone lifecycle, critical-entity transcription, accessibility and mode-handoff usability

gates.title: Coding-runtime and model roster
gates.evidence_required: Authenticated target model list/IDs, client version, tools, effort controls, billing route, sandbox/approval configuration and bounded smoke tests
gates.safe_behavior: Harness validation, planning and manual bootstrap continue; no guessed model availability

gates.title: Conversation export completeness
gates.evidence_required: Raw user-visible thread export when available; reconcile against coverage ledger
gates.blocks: Claim of byte-complete conversation archive only
gates.safe_behavior: Authoritative specs and all recorded decisions remain implementable
